title: Vivian Blank 17
author: bpatrick
body: Vivian’s back! I like the way this one turned out. I should have a b & w ESAD tomorrow which hardly makes up for no color ESAD on Monday but I have to let it go. One week ’til I head for always-sunny Ohio. Hopefully this is my last week working a bullshit job – ever. Hopefully. I’m starting a new Curious Urgency page right now. (Riiiiigggghhhht —- now!)
